title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.31
subtitle: GAIA appears for every account that may download it.

highlights.title: GAIA builds are offered again
highlights.description: Preferences shows the GAIA build the PolyWorks server lists for your account, labelled Dev or Public release.

highlights.title: Exact build updates
highlights.description: A different GAIA build is offered even when its version number is not higher.

highlights.title: Clearer Reproducible Bake hint
highlights.description: The hint names what is not covered yet: static colliders, rigid bodies and translation locks.
